title: Beyond the Lab: Understanding OpenDDE and the Rise of Open-Source Foundation Models in Drug Discovery
angle: We break down what Aureka AI's OpenDDE means for pharmaceutical research, explaining how an all-atom biomolecular foundation model accelerates drug design and what 'open-source' truly signifies in this high-stakes domain.
rationale: Story 2 is a significant open-source release in a crucial sector, and an explainer will clarify its technical impact for a broader audience.

source_articles.title: Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine
source_articles.excerpt: arXiv:2607.03787v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine.
